class.name: BoxSet
class.description:
BoxSet is a resource that defines the visual configuration of the battle board on which the player's SOUL moves during combat. It allows you to set the board's color, border color, and the textures used for the attack meter.
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

members.member:
The base color of the battle board.
Defines the background color of the board where the player's SOUL is located during combat. Used to set the mood and visual effect of the board. The default value is a semi-transparent black.

The border color of the battle board.
Defines the border color of the board where the player's SOUL is located during combat. Used to enhance the boundary and visual distinction of the board. The default value is an opaque white.
The texture for the meter displayed when attacking.
The scale of the meter displayed when attacking.
